_about: The IE Hub's pillars and the site roadmap. The footer and public/roadmap.html are built from this file and so is the home page (public/index.html). Pillar status: live, soon or planned; only live pillars become links. Phase status: done, next, along (in progress alongside the others), planned or later. Updates list only what visitors notice: no hosting or repository details. __COURSES__, __MODULES__, __VERIFIED__, __COVERED__, __TOTAL__ and __OPEN__ are filled in from the courses at build time. start: course slugs shown as start-here links on the home page.

pillars.name: Learn
pillars.blurb: Open courses with datasets you can rerun, a learning path by role and a mind map of the field.

pillars.name: Projects
pillars.blurb: Worked cases from the courses, followed from problem to result, with simulated data you can rerun.

pillars.name: Insights
pillars.blurb: Plain-language notes: how a problem was solved, a research paper explained, a tool reviewed.

pillars.name: Collaborate
pillars.blurb: Review a course, propose one of the open topics, or start a project together.

goal: A free, open home for industrial engineering. It teaches with open courses and data you can rerun, explains in plain language, shows worked projects from problem to result, and opens the door to anyone who wants to review, propose or build. Further out: name a role, say continuous improvement engineer, and get a training plan through the courses here.

phases.title: Catalog
phases.body: Original courses grouped the way the IISE catalog groups the discipline, with a learning path, a mind map and an on-site reader that keeps your progress in your browser.

phases.title: Hub home
phases.body: The hub page at the site root; the catalog, learning path and mind map at /learn; a top bar for the whole hub; a new footer; this roadmap.

phases.title: Trust
phases.body: Every course was written with AI assistance and stays draft until a named person verifies it. This runs alongside the other phases.
items: __VERIFIED__ of __COURSES__ courses verified; first goal: 2 to 3, with reviewer credits

phases.title: Projects and Collaborate
phases.body: Worked projects from the course case companies, problem to result. A Collaborate page: review a course, propose one of the __OPEN__ open topics, start a project, through GitHub Discussions.

phases.title: Insights
phases.body: Short articles in plain language: how a problem was solved, a paper explained, a tool reviewed. First three, then two a month.

phases.title: Role profiles
phases.body: One profile per target role from O*NET and BLS, ranked by importance and mapped to the modules that teach it. The gaps feed the course list.

phases.title: Advisor
phases.body: Pick a role, say what you already know, and get a training plan through the courses here, with every focus point citing its source.

phases.title: Keeping current and growth
phases.body: Sources refreshed on a schedule, with what changed shown per role; a newsletter, outreach to university IE departments, guest authors.

updates.text: A new home page for the hub; the catalog, learning path and mind map move to /learn, and old links still work.
The site is now at theiehub.com.
The IE Hub name and logo adopted.
